tests: Presentation-style landscape layout with floating boxes whose visual position contradicts their logical order. AccessPDF reports PowerPoint-derived PDFs as a known weak case; this reproduces that shape.
adversarialFeatures: absolutely positioned boxes with no flow order
box 3 sits highest on the page but is logically last; box 1 is lower-left
large numerals are visual ornament attached to headings, not list markers
purely decorative blobs and a gradient stripe with no informational content
title: Coastal: three ways forward
readingOrderNote: Logical order is 1, 2, 3 by the numerals. Pure geometry gives 3, 1, 2 because box 3 is highest. A geometry-only reading order will get this wrong, and that is the point of the document.

lists.note: The three boxes form a numbered sequence visually but are not marked up as a list. Treating them as three separate sections is acceptable; inventing list semantics is not required.

decorativeGraphics.expectedHandling: Part of the heading text or an artifact. Not content in their own right.

intentionalProblems: geometric reading order disagrees with logical order
three decorative shapes that must not become figures
readingOrderAnchorsNote: Literal text expected in this relative order in the tagged content. readingOrder above is prose and cannot be matched automatically; these can. Logical order is 1,2,3 by the numerals. Pure geometry gives 3,1,2 because box 3 sits highest.
